holderQuote: It was his duty. He couldn’t risk the carriage or even himself, no matter what. Reynold tried to close his ears to the screaming. He told himself he was doing his job. He was just a [Butler].
Reynold was enjoying a cup of tea in the kitchen. He was eating a sandwich. Ressa whispered in his ears as she stood upside-down right behind him.
Reynold the [Butler] adjusted his uniform as he stepped smartly over to the fallen [Thug Boss].
Reynold was wounded. He’d broken something in the fall. But he had artifacts too. Now he leapt with a roar, his sword aimed for the [Assassin]’s back.
Sacra lay halfway across the inside, on his lap. Reynold looked down at her. He looked at her blank eyes. The [Butler] rose, slowly.
No compliments from the [Combat Butler], no polite greeting; Lyonette piled in with Wilovan and Ratici.

Speaking of Dragons imbibing sugar…well, it was a peculiar thing. But as Reynold, [Combat Butler], driver for Magnolia Reinhart’s famous carriage, looked on, he couldn’t actually remember if Eldavin—that was, Teriarch, that was, Eldavin—had a sweet tooth or not.
Wilovan and Ratici looked at Reynold. The [Combat Butler] offered them a cup.
Mrsha hid under a seat as Reynold swerved right and left
Reynold had one, as did Ressa. The [Combat Butler] bowed.
